I read "average scenario" as the mean across each scheme's fee rules, using fee = fixed_amount + rate × 4321 / 10000. The ranking is close:

| Card scheme | Rules | Avg fee (EUR) |
|---|---|---|
| NexPay | 191 | 24.01 |
| SwiftCharge | 270 | 23.93 |
